decisions.decision: D2 revised: use nx:run-commands + tsc --noEmit for non-Angular typecheck (NOT @nx/js:tsc)
decisions.rationale: Verified twice against @nx/js@23.0.1 source: @nx/js:tsc schema requires main+outputPath, forces outDir, sets noEmitOnError, calls program.emit() and treats emitSkipped as failure -> noEmit is a guaranteed CI-red. Nx's inferred typecheck uses tsc --build --emitDeclarationOnly (emits) and self-disables on noEmit. tsc --noEmit -p is the real no-emit primitive.

decisions.decision: Angular projects (app, consumer libs, clean fixtures) dogfood angular-typechecker:typecheck
decisions.rationale: It honors noEmit (performCompilation, not program.emit) and adds NG8xxx template diagnostics tsc can't.
